title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.21898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents promise to automate complex digital workflows, but their training remains limited by synthetic environments that look plausible while hiding broken links, inconsistent states, or infeasible tasks. We address the gap between scalable environment generation and trustworthy agent learning by constructing synthetic web environments that are executable, auditable, and grounded in backend state. Our framework represents each generated website as a structured scaffold of pages, navigation links, database records, state-change markers, and task constraints, then verifies and repairs structural, semantic, consistency, and feasibility defects before policy training. During interaction, ordinary UI transitions are executed deterministically, while persistent backend updates are invoked only through validated state-change markers, enabling dense rewards compiled from verified task-progress predicates. translated_title: 训练需要可信的世界：用于智能体学习的验证合成网络环境
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21898v1 公告类型：新 摘要：网络智能体有望自动化复杂的数字工作流，但其训练仍受限于合成环境，这些环境看似合理，却隐藏着断链、状态不一致或不可行的任务。我们通过构建可执行、可审计且基于后端状态的可信合成网络环境，弥合了可扩展环境生成与可信智能体学习之间的差距。我们的框架将每个生成的网站表示为页面、导航链接、数据库记录、状态变化标记和任务约束的结构化脚手架，然后在策略训练前验证并修复结构、语义、一致性和可行性缺陷。在交互过程中，普通UI转换被确定性执行，而持久化后端更新仅通过验证过的状态变化标记调用，从而实现从验证过的任务进度谓词编译出的密集奖励。在500个合成环境中，跨度...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种框架，通过结构化脚手架生成可执行、可审计且基于后端状态的合成网络环境，并自动验证修复缺陷，从而为网络智能体提供可信的训练环境。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that generates executable, auditable, and backend-grounded synthetic web environments via structured scaffolds with automated verification and repair, enabling trustworthy training for web agents.
